notes.title: Massive update(Version3.0)
notes.content:
[h2][b]Bug fix[/b][/h2]
[h3]・Fixed the game sometimes freezes when selecting the language in Title> Settings[/h3]

[h2][b]システム[/b][/h2]
[h3]・New system "Auto Setting" added[/h3]

[h2][b]Game Play[/b][/h2]
[h3]・New operation "slow" added[/h3]

[h3]・New system "gimmick" added[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36218419/8100ff2c30cb1d9b656050b4716c1b6db1447351.png[/img]Bush
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36218419/0532ea41e63457016d647aec164792219119926b.png[/img]Portal
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36218419/a8cadef508746223e44178e0e48af891f567e72b.png[/img]Capture Mine
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36218419/902c6180cb2e214fd563c52b32030b34c8f02c6f.png[/img]Mine Factory

[h3]・New system "Trait" added[/h3]

[h3]・New game rule "Survival" added[/h3]

[h3]・Remake all stages[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36218419/f87ca4b343a8e861bddde0ebf228e8bef8a4dc6e.png[/img]

[h3]・6 new stages added[/h3]

[h3]Removed the same type skills cooldown sharing[/h3]

[h3]・New skills added[/h3]
🆕[i]Leap[/i]
🆕[i]Claw[/i]

[h3]・Skill deleted[/h3]
ːRivalsː[i]Adrenaline[/i]

[h3]・Skill balance[/h3]

🔵[i]Thunder[/i]
Aiming has gradually increased
Infinite aiming duration

🔵[i]Mirage[/i]
Cooldown reduction 6 seconds → 4 seconds
Fake movement direction changed from random to always forward

🔵[i]Masquerade[/i]
Fake duration extension 6 seconds → 12 seconds
Old fake will now disappear when using a skill

🔵[i]Portal[/i]
Infinite duration
It became possible to specify the installation direction

🔵[i]Turret[/i]
Infinite duration
It became possible to specify the installation direction
Shoot can now be destroyed with Ray

🔻[i]Shift[/i]
Shoot duration reduced from 12 seconds to 3 seconds
The moving speed of the shoot decreases

🔻[i]Mine[/i]
No longer detects enemies for 1 second after installation
Infinite duration

🔻[i]Abyss[/i]
The timing when the hit judgment occurs is slightly delayed
Cooldown slightly extended
The attack range has become slightly smaller

🔻[i]Spirit[/i]
Reduced movement speed when in movement mode

◇[i]Gemini[/i]
Shoot becomes indestructible with Ray
Hit detection no longer occurs near the shoot

[h3]・Reduce game speed[/h3]
Slowing down the player's basic movement speed.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------
